noMentions: No file of this worktree was named in the run yet.
noWorktree: This task has no worktree of its own, so there are no files to show.
ignoredNote: Gitignored. It stays closed until you open it.
linkNote: A link or junction. It is shown but never followed.
binary: Binary file, {{size}}. It is not shown.

files.outside: That path leads outside the worktree, so it is not shown.
files.not_found: That file is no longer there.
files.missing: The worktree folder is gone. It may be parked; resume it to see its files.
files.no_worktree: This task has no worktree of its own.
